items.description: The 99designs Tasks Slack Bot is a full featured graphic design assistant application in Slack.
A mashup based on the Sick Bay Scanner from the original Star Trek. It uses the Yahoo YUI API to capture a stock price and a handful of stock ratios which it applies to the scanner.

SDMX-SAX Faces brings together multiple free SDMX (Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange) data services in one data portal. One of these data services is OECD, which is integrated via the OECD Open Data API.
Compare new homes, home designs, builders, land estate, house plans, via Google Maps in Australia.
Videos, photos, and panorama of Chile that helps tourists or others find restaurants, points of interest, banks, gas stations, and more in Chile.
Let Santa Call makes phone calls to your friends, and play them a Christmas song.
Mapping application for locating real estate listings in the UK.
The Weekend Warrior Hike Finder for Los Angeles and surrounding areas. Warning, can load slowly.
The first Self-Referential Tumblr. Your page accesses are our posts. A mashup of Tumblr and Clicky.
Uses the Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs to connect people using webcams.
Live Plasma is a discovery site that helps users find similar content. It displays the results in easy to navigate layouts with impressive visuals.
Explore relationship between artists. Idea based on six degrees theory: no artist is separated from another by more than six other artists. 3rd place winner in Amazon developer contest.
US Home Care Finder is a place for people to find the best in-home care and home health agencies in their area. You can view detail information on over 10,000 agencies and compare quality.
Get notified via SMS when people purchase from your magento powered ecommerce site. Send order status, dispatch and delivery notifications out by SMS.
Route Scanner automatically works out relevant traffic incidents which could affect your journey and displays them on an interactive map. It uses RSS feeds from the BBC and Highways Agency. UK Only.
A Cross-platform app built using Appcelerator and the OTNet.tv media API.
Mashup satellite images from BBC Weather and t7online. See the Instructions tab to see how to do it.

Code collaboration tool for web developers with Basecamp integration. Besides importing people, messaging development log, you can review closed tasks and approve them or not directly on a site, seeing how the work is actually done.
Showing Supinfo, a graduate school of computer science, in different cities in France, China, Canada and the UK.
Google Map of earthquakes worldwide within the past seven days.
Find out estimated carbon emissions and fuel costs based on the driving directions you provide. Enter your daily commute or any other trip. View various ideas about how to reduce your emissions.

Check the open hours and location of a business in your local community before you go. Relies on community members in towns and cities to build up the database of businesses and their operating hours.
A map of limo service providers in the USA. Locate a provider in your area and then access information about their company and-or request a free quote.
Find the good times. partyGPS makes it easier to locate bars, clubs, and liquor stores throughout the U.S. with Google Maps and user reviews.
South America-related maps. Sophisticated map search.

LazyTweet is a question and answer service built on Twitter. By embracing and extending the questions already being asked on twitter, it gives an added chance of getting an answer by exposing questions beyond a user's followers.
Qualis is a website for real estate in The Netherlands.
A stylish-looking interactive Google map showing over 120 of Japan's original, rebuilt & ruined castles. Plenty of features, overlays, etc.
People Search World is a people search engine allows anyone to search public records, emails, US addresses, phone numbers and more for millions of people nationwide.
Free PBX for SMS and phone calls with random strangers, while keeping your number and identity private.
On-demand service offering management infrastructure and community building tools for API providers. Uses the Amazon S3 and EC2 APIs as part of their infrastructure.
This useful mashup helps you find good quality, free online course material from schools worldwide including Harvard and MIT. Both video and audio content available.
KnowledgeTreeLive is a hosted, on-demand edition of the KnowledgeTree Document Management Software to manage documents, secure documents, and collaborate.

Customize a UK road trip, choose stop off points along the way - restaurants, cafes, petrol stations, child friendly venues - and also has an avoid motorways function. The route can be emailed and printed.
Tarpipe is a social media platform that automates the process of discovering and distributing information on multiple web applications, using a visual, workflow oriented interface.
Allows Box.net users to share files from their Box accounts using TimeBridge, where they can discuss and collaborate around them in real-time with other users.
twitQA is a place where you can see followers interacting with each other in a most knowledgeable way. Everything is asked, answered and discussed by people like you.
Virtual Earth tour of New York City using Google Earth and Mapfish.

222acres.com is a real estate portal in India. It consumes numerous APIs to provide a better property locating and search experience to its users for buying, selling, or renting properties. 222acres.com is known for its attention to quality levels, client focused approach, on time deliveries, excellent commercial morality, and transparency.
Hamkry is an online booking company that provides customers access to travel-related information such as booking flights, buses, hotels, and car rentals.
Eliminate dropped calls and increase data speeds with a signal booster.
A real estate site for the Greek market.
